method.execution: Latest repository-native adapter logic was fetched from the GitHub branches at their current PR heads and its represented semantics were reconstructed and executed in an isolated local Python harness. Container-side direct clone was unavailable because external DNS/network access was unavailable. No claim of clean-clone CI is made.

implementations.name: m0-durable-run
observations: same run_id with a different execution request is now explicitly rejected
same run_id with the same request remains replay-safe
cache fresh -> stale successor preserves the original record

implementations.name: unified-knowledge-work-system
observations: run identity replay for a changed goal is not represented by the inspected UWS runtime
cache reference persistence is atomic and stale state remains readable

limits: freshness is represented, not independently proven against source drift
cache material has not crossed an independent Verification boundary
